question: As per the report released by NITI Aayog in September 2021 entitled 'Best Practices in the Performance of District Hospitals', on average, how many beds per lakh population do district hospitals have?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24 beds.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **District hospitals** have on average **24 beds per lakh **population.
 
• The report released by **NITI Aayog **in **September 2021** highlights the best practices in the performance of district hospitals across India.
 
• The report aims to provide insights into the functioning of district hospitals and suggests ways to** improve their performance.**
 
• The report also emphasizes the need to strengthen the** infrastructure and resources **of district hospitals to provide quality healthcare to the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** highest-ranking think tank **for public policy within the Indian government is called **NITI Aayog.**
 
• It was replaced by the **NDA government in 2015** as a top-down model replaced by the Planning Commission.
 
• The** Lieutenant Governors** of each UT, the** Chief Ministers **of Delhi and Puducherry, all state chief ministers, and a** vice-chairman **chosen by the prime minister make up the NITI Aayog council.
 
• 
 
 
 
 Its chairperson is **Narendra Modi.**

 It was founded on **1 January 2015.**
